message: Heads-up: our last few sprints finished only a small share of committed work and one closed late. Let's agree early what we drop if the bugs take longer than expected.
We've committed 44 issues, but we've been finishing about 20 per sprint and two of the last three sprints closed late. Let's trim scope now so we can close on the planned date.
Two of our last three sprints closed late, and we've barely been finishing committed bugs. Six of the seven have no estimate, so let's size them today and cut anything we can't realistically close.
All of our last three sprints closed late, by about 16 days on average, and we carried 25 issues over. Let's split the 47-point story and set a firm close date before we start.
